newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady in quiet market.

text.p: NWE naphtha was steady on Friday in a quiet market as many traders wound down operations ahead of the coming long weekend, traders said.
Naphtha swaps were quoted around $184/$185 for May while June was assessed at around $187.50/$188.50 as crude future gains helped lift them off earlier lower le levels.
The physical market was relatively quiet.
One player said they had sold 12-14,000 tonnes worth of barges out of Antwerp at a rate of cif mean quotes basis fob over the past few days.
A Dutch player said they had picked up a Russian cargo of some 13,000 tonnes of Dow spec material at $178 cif Rotterdam on Wednesday.
Trade on Friday, however, was relatively quiet with many players leaving early ahead of the long weekend due to a public holiday on Monday across most of Europe.
